description: A quantizer that keeps the octaves a volt apart but re-tunes the twelve notes inside each one to the square roots of whole numbers

inputs.text: The pitch to quantize: the whole-volt part is carried through as the octave, and the fractional part is cut into twelve equal steps which are then re-spaced onto the square-root scale

outputs.text: The re-tuned pitch; 0V in gives 0V out and each whole volt in moves the output by a whole volt, so octaves keep their spacing while the notes inside them move

notes: a negative input gives 0V at the output, so the module only follows pitches from 0V upwards
with nothing patched into V/OCT the output is held at 0V
one voltage in and one voltage out, mono, with nothing to set and no menu of its own

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.

outputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
